articles.title: A Big Storm Called Isaias Is Heading for the U.S. Gulf Coast
articles.summary: Tropical Storm Isaias may become a hurricane and reach the U.S. Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday.

articles.title: Two People Running for Georgia Governor Hold a TV Debate
articles.summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms and Rick Jackson, who want to be Georgia's next governor, answered voters' questions in their only TV debate.

articles.title: Police Are Using More Computer Tools to Watch Cities
articles.summary: More police departments are using AI software that combines many cameras and data in one place, and some experts worry about privacy.
